2607.21101.title: Can Generative Recommendation Reach Cold Items? A Temporal Perspective on Semantic-ID Generation
2607.21101.paper_summary: Semantic-ID-based generative recommendation represents items as sequences of shared semantic tokens, enabling token recombination beyond isolated item IDs. However, closed-world recombination does not necessarily imply temporal open-token cold-start induction, where new items enter the item catalog with unseen atomic tokens or weakly supported SID paths. In this work, we revisit SID-based generative recommendation under an absolute-time temporal protocol that separates seen and unseen targets and diagnoses the cold item reachability at the token level. Through seen/unseen-hit analysis, coldness taxonomy, and oracle-prefix probing, we show that current SID-based models can occasionally reach future items supported by observed tokens and prefixes, but struggle with unseen atomic tokens and unsupported SID paths. We further explain this boundary by interpreting SID generation as hierarchical semantic bucketing: early tokens select coarse semantic regions, while later tokens refine item-specific paths. These findings show that SID generation is compositional but not fully open-ended, and suggest future directions in more independent SID spaces, scoring-based interfaces, and dynamic textual context.
2607.21101.paper_summary_zh: 語義ID基礎的生成推薦將項目表示為共享語義標記的序列，使得標記的重組超越孤立的項目ID。然而，封閉世界的重組並不一定意味著時間上的開放標記冷啟動引導，其中新項目以未見的原子標記或支持度較弱的SID路徑進入項目目錄。在這項工作中，我們在一個絕對時間的時間協議下重新檢視基於SID的生成推薦，該協議將已見和未見的目標分開，並在標記層面診斷冷項目的可達性。通過已見/未見命中分析、冷度分類法和神諭前綴探測，我們顯示當前基於SID的模型有時可以通過觀察到的標記和前綴達到未來項目，但在未見的原子標記和不支持的SID路徑上則面臨挑戰。我們進一步通過將SID生成解釋為分層語義分桶來解釋這一邊界：早期標記選擇粗略的語義區域，而後期標記則細化特定項目的路徑。這些發現表明SID生成是組合性的，但並非完全開放的，並建議在更獨立的SID空間、基於評分的介面和動態文本上下文中探索未來的方向。
